title: T07d — Opt-in automatic update policy, off by default, for selected channels and targets
goal: Opt-in automatic update policy, off by default, for selected channels and targets.
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: Opt-in automatic update policy, off by default, for selected channels and targets
Show installed/running and available revisions/channel with compatibility, checked time and explicit unavailable/offline states on companion, dashboard and status report
Use one validated backend update contract across all surfaces; an available version is not an applied update

Offer reviewed manual updates through T06 admission/recovery and an explicit opt-in automatic update policy for selected supported channels/targets; preserve fencing, backups, ownership, interruption and pending-work checks
Automatic updates remain disabled unless configured and accepted; never silently downgrade schema or bypass unsupported compatibility/recovery; report failures and next recovery action
validation: Meaningful cross-boundary regressions and required final CI
Explicit selected-target acceptance where service, install or real device behavior is required; static/unit passes do not substitute
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never change an unowned installation, service, engine or uncertain physical effect without explicit reconciliation

effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T07d of the step "Update experience: availability, status and opt-in automatic updates". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one.
